short.en: Return per unit of total volatility. The most common way to compare risk-adjusted performance between strategies.
short.zh: 每承担一单位波动所获得的收益，是比较不同策略风险调整后表现最常用的指标。

terms.formula: Sharpe = mean(daily return) / std(daily return) × √252

paragraphs.en: We take the strategy's daily returns inside the selected window, divide their average by their standard deviation, and annualize with the square root of 252 trading days. The risk-free rate is set to zero so that strategies on different assets and periods stay comparable.
paragraphs.zh: 取策略在所选时间窗口内的日收益，用平均值除以标准差，再乘以 252 个交易日的平方根做年化。无风险利率设为 0，方便在不同品种和时间段之间横向比较。

paragraphs.en: Below 0 means the strategy lost money on average. Around 0.5 is typical for a buy-and-hold equity index over long periods; 1.0 or more sustained over many years is rare for a simple rule-based strategy. Values above 3 on daily data almost always point to a data problem, a very short sample or overfitting rather than a genuine edge.
paragraphs.zh: 小于 0 说明平均在亏钱。长期持有股指的夏普一般在 0.5 左右；简单规则策略能在多年里稳定保持 1.0 以上就很少见了。日频数据算出 3 以上，多半是数据有问题、样本太短或过拟合，而不是真的有优势。

paragraphs.en: Sharpe treats upside and downside volatility the same and assumes returns are roughly normal. Strategies that sell volatility or average down can show a high Sharpe right up until a large loss. Always read it together with maximum drawdown and the length of the history.
paragraphs.zh: 夏普把上涨和下跌的波动一视同仁，还默认收益大致服从正态分布。卖波动率或亏损加仓的策略，在大亏之前夏普往往很好看。一定要和最大回撤、样本长度一起看。

short.en: Like the Sharpe ratio, but only downside volatility counts as risk.
short.zh: 和夏普比率类似，但只把下跌的波动算作风险。

terms.formula: Sortino = mean(daily return) / std(negative daily returns) × √252

paragraphs.en: We divide the average daily return by the standard deviation of the days with a negative return only, then annualize with √252. Days with a gain do not increase the denominator, so a strategy with large up days is not penalised for them.
paragraphs.zh: 用日收益的平均值，除以只算亏损日的收益标准差，再乘以 √252 年化。赚钱的日子不会放大分母，所以大涨的日子不会被当成风险扣分。

heading.zh: 什么时候和夏普差得多

paragraphs.en: Trend-following strategies often have a Sortino well above their Sharpe because their volatility comes from a few large winning moves. If Sortino is close to or below Sharpe, the losses are as large as the gains, which is typical of mean-reversion or option-selling style returns.
paragraphs.zh: 趋势跟踪策略的索提诺通常明显高于夏普，因为它的波动主要来自少数几次大赚。如果索提诺和夏普差不多甚至更低，说明亏的时候和赚的时候一样猛，这在均值回归或卖期权类收益里很常见。

short.en: Annual growth rate divided by the worst peak-to-trough loss. Answers: how much return per unit of pain?
short.zh: 年化增长率除以最大回撤，回答的是：每承受一单位最大亏损，能换来多少收益。

terms.formula: Calmar = CAGR / |Maximum drawdown|

paragraphs.en: A Calmar of 1 means the strategy earns in one year roughly what it lost in its worst drawdown. Above 1 over a long window is good; below 0.3 means investors had to sit through a deep loss for modest returns. Because it depends on a single worst episode, Calmar can change sharply when a new drawdown happens.
paragraphs.zh: 卡玛比率为 1，意味着一年赚的钱大约等于最惨那次回撤亏掉的钱。长期窗口里大于 1 算不错；低于 0.3 说明为了不多的收益要熬过很深的亏损。它只看最差的那一次，所以一旦出现新的大回撤，数值会变化很大。

paragraphs.en: Calmar is computed for every window (1M to Max) from that window's CAGR and maximum drawdown, and it is one of the inputs of the Arena Score. Short windows can produce extreme values, so prefer the 3Y, 5Y or Max windows when comparing.
paragraphs.zh: 每个时间窗口（1 个月到全部历史）都用该窗口的年化收益和最大回撤单独计算卡玛比率，它也是 Arena Score 的组成部分之一。短窗口容易出现极端值，比较时优先看 3 年、5 年或全部历史。

short.en: The largest fall from a previous peak in the equity curve. The single best measure of how painful a strategy was to hold.
short.zh: 权益曲线从前高到之后最低点的最大跌幅，最能说明一个策略拿在手里有多难受。

terms.formula: Max drawdown = min over t of (Equity_t / max(Equity_0..t) − 1)

paragraphs.en: A 50% drawdown needs a 100% gain to recover. Most people abandon a strategy during a deep drawdown, so a system with a slightly lower return and a much smaller drawdown is often the one that actually gets followed.
paragraphs.zh: 回撤 50%，需要涨 100% 才能回本。大多数人会在深度回撤中放弃策略，所以收益略低、但回撤小得多的系统，往往才是真正能坚持执行的那个。

paragraphs.en: Depth is only half of the story. A 20% drawdown that recovers in two months feels very different from one that lasts three years. The drawdown chart on every strategy page shows both depth and how long the equity stayed under water.
paragraphs.zh: 深度只是一半。两个月就修复的 20% 回撤，和持续三年的 20% 回撤，感受完全不同。每个策略页的回撤图会同时显示回撤深度和“水下”时间。

short.en: The constant yearly growth rate that would turn the starting equity into the ending equity over the same period.
short.zh: 假设每年以同样的速度增长，从起点权益增长到终点权益所需要的年化增长率。

terms.formula: CAGR = (Equity_end / Equity_start)^(1 / years) − 1

paragraphs.en: CAGR makes periods of different length comparable. It says nothing about the path, so two strategies with the same CAGR can have very different drawdowns. Very short windows (one or three months) annualize a few weeks of luck into a large number, which is why rankings on short windows are noisy.
paragraphs.zh: CAGR 让不同长度的时间段可以直接比较，但它不反映过程：年化收益一样的两个策略，回撤可能天差地别。1 个月、3 个月这种短窗口，会把几周的运气放大成一个很大的年化数字，所以短窗口的排名噪音很大。

short.en: How much daily returns swing around their average, scaled to a yearly figure.
short.zh: 日收益围绕均值上下波动的幅度，换算成年度数值。

terms.formula: Volatility = std(daily return) × √252

paragraphs.en: A US equity index typically runs at 15–20% annualized volatility; bitcoin often runs above 60%. Timing strategies that spend part of the time in cash usually show lower volatility than buy-and-hold on the same asset, which is one of the main reasons they exist.
paragraphs.zh: 美股指数的年化波动率通常在 15%–20%，比特币经常超过 60%。择时策略有一部分时间空仓，所以波动率通常比同一品种的买入持有低，这也是它们存在的主要价值之一。

short.en: In Quant Arena: the share of trading days with a positive strategy return. Not the share of winning trades.
short.zh: 在 Quant Arena 里指：策略日收益为正的交易日占比，而不是盈利交易笔数的占比。

terms.formula: Win rate = days with return > 0 / all days in the window

paragraphs.en: Because days spent in cash have a zero return, they count as non-winning days. A strategy that is invested only 40% of the time will therefore show a low win rate even if its trades are very good. Use it to compare strategies with similar exposure, and look at the profit factor and the drawdown at the same time.
paragraphs.zh: 空仓的日子收益为 0，会被算成“没赢”。所以一个只有 40% 时间持仓的策略，即使每笔交易都很漂亮，胜率也会偏低。只在持仓比例相近的策略之间比较胜率，并同时看盈亏比和回撤。

paragraphs.en: Trend-following systems often win on fewer than half of their days or trades and still make money through a few large gains. Martingale and grid systems show the opposite pattern: very high win rates until one loss wipes out months of gains.
paragraphs.zh: 趋势跟踪系统经常不到一半的时间在赚钱，但靠少数几次大赚整体盈利。马丁格尔和网格系统正好相反：胜率很高，直到某一次亏损吃掉几个月的利润。

short.en: Total gains divided by total losses. Above 1 means the strategy made more than it lost.
short.zh: 总盈利除以总亏损。大于 1 说明赚的比亏的多。

terms.formula: Profit factor = Σ positive daily returns / |Σ negative daily returns|

paragraphs.en: We use daily strategy returns rather than individual trades, so the number is comparable across strategies with very different trade counts. Values between 1.1 and 1.5 are typical for robust daily strategies; much higher values on a long history deserve a closer look for look-ahead bias or a very small sample.
paragraphs.zh: 我们用的是策略的日收益，而不是逐笔交易，所以交易次数差别很大的策略之间也能比较。稳健的日频策略一般在 1.1 到 1.5 之间；长样本里明显更高的数值，要警惕未来函数或样本太少。

short.en: How much the position changes on an average day. Higher turnover means higher trading costs in real life.
short.zh: 平均每天仓位变化的幅度。换手越高，实盘交易成本越高。

terms.formula: Turnover = average daily |position_t − position_t−1|

paragraphs.en: Backtests on this site do not subtract commissions or slippage. A strategy with high turnover can look good on paper and lose most of its edge after costs, while a slow strategy with a weaker headline number may survive them. Use turnover as a warning light when comparing returns.
paragraphs.zh: 本站的回测没有扣除佣金和滑点。高换手的策略可能纸面上很好看，扣掉成本后优势所剩无几；而收益数字一般、但交易很慢的策略，反而能扛住成本。比较收益时，把换手率当成一盏警示灯。

short.en: Quant Arena's composite rating: a weighted average of five percentile ranks against every strategy on the same market and window.
short.zh: Quant Arena 的综合评分：和同一品种、同一窗口内所有策略比较，把五个分项的百分位加权平均。

terms.formula: Score = 0.30·Quality + 0.25·Drawdown + 0.20·Consistency + 0.15·Robustness + 0.10·Significance (each 0–100)

paragraphs.en: Return quality ranks the Sharpe and Sortino ratios. Drawdown control ranks the Calmar ratio and the Ulcer index (lower is better). Consistency ranks the share of positive months and the time spent below a previous peak. Robustness ranks the worst Sharpe ratio the strategy had across the 1-year, 3-year, 5-year and full windows, which punishes strategies that only worked in one period. Significance is the probabilistic Sharpe ratio: the chance that the true Sharpe is above zero given the length and shape of the return history.
paragraphs.zh: 收益质量看夏普和索提诺比率的排名；回撤控制看卡玛比率和 Ulcer 指数（越低越好）；稳定性看正收益月份占比和低于前高的时间；稳健性看策略在 1 年、3 年、5 年和全部历史里最差的那个夏普，只在某一段时间有效的策略会被扣分；统计可信度是概率夏普比率，也就是结合收益序列的长度和形状，真实夏普大于 0 的可能性。

paragraphs.en: The first version added raw metrics together and clipped the result to 0–100, so in strong markets many strategies tied at 100 and in weak ones many tied at 0. Ranking each component within the same market and window keeps the scale comparable, stops a single extreme value from dominating, and makes ties rare. The old score is still stored as arenaScoreV1 in the data files.
paragraphs.zh: 第一版把原始指标直接相加再截断到 0–100，行情好时很多策略并列 100 分，行情差时很多并列 0 分。在同一品种、同一窗口内对每个分项排名，尺度可比，单个极端值也无法主导，并列也很少出现。旧版分数仍以 arenaScoreV1 保存在数据文件里。

paragraphs.en: Strategies that were in the market less than 5% of the time in a window get no score for that window: there are too few active days to judge them. A score is a starting point for comparison, not a recommendation.
paragraphs.zh: 某个窗口内持仓时间不到 5% 的策略，在这个窗口里不打分：有效交易日太少，没法判断。分数只是比较的起点，不是投资建议。

short.en: Choosing parameters on past data only, then testing them on the following unseen period, over and over.
short.zh: 只用过去的数据选参数，再在紧接着的、没见过的时间段上检验，并不断向前滚动。

terms.formula: Train 3 years → pick best parameters → trade the next 6 months → roll forward

paragraphs.en: If you pick the best parameters using the whole history, the backtest already knows the future and will look better than reality. Walk-forward optimization only ever uses information that would have been available at the time, which gives a more honest estimate of live performance.
paragraphs.zh: 如果用全部历史去挑最优参数，回测就等于提前知道了未来，结果一定比实际好看。滚动前推优化每一步只用当时已经能拿到的信息，对实盘表现的估计更诚实。

paragraphs.en: Each strategy is trained on a 3-year window and then traded for the next 6 months with the chosen parameters, rolling forward through the history. The walk-forward result is what we show. Until 3 November 2026 we kept the default parameters whenever they did better over the whole history, but that choice itself looked at the full sample and made about one in five results slightly optimistic, so we dropped it.
paragraphs.zh: 每个策略用 3 年数据训练，再用选出的参数交易接下来的 6 个月，并在整段历史里向前滚动。网站展示的就是滚动前推的结果。2026 年 11 月 3 日之前，如果默认参数在整段历史上表现更好，我们会保留默认参数；但这个选择本身看过了整段样本，让大约五分之一的结果略偏乐观，所以已经取消。

heading.en: How much survives out of sample

paragraphs.en: Every strategy page now has an out-of-sample check. Across the 486 strategy-and-market pairs with parameters to tune (data through 3 November 2026), the settings chosen on each 3-year training window had a median Sharpe ratio of **0.32** there, but only **0.19** in the six months after each choice, when they were actually traded. In 357 of the 486 pairs (73%) the out-of-sample Sharpe ratio was lower than the training one.
paragraphs.zh: 每个策略页面现在都有“样本外检验”。在 486 个有参数可调的“策略 × 市场”组合里（数据截至 2026 年 11 月 3 日），每次在 3 年训练期里选出的参数，训练期内夏普中位数是 **0.32**；到了之后 6 个月真正交易时，只剩 **0.19**。486 个组合中有 357 个（73%）样本外夏普低于训练期。

paragraphs.en: Re-selecting the parameters was not a clear win either: over the same out-of-sample months it beat simply keeping the default settings in 248 of the 486 pairs, about half. That is why we treat walk-forward results as an honest estimate, not as proof that tuning adds value, and why each strategy page shows both numbers side by side.
paragraphs.zh: 重新选参数也谈不上明显更好：在同样的样本外月份里，只有 248 个组合（大约一半）跑赢了一直用默认参数。所以我们把滚动前推的结果当作更诚实的估计，而不是“调参有用”的证据；每个策略页面也把两个数字并排列出来。

short.en: Doubling the position after each loss so that one win recovers everything. High win rate, rare but catastrophic losses.
short.zh: 每亏一次就加倍下注，指望一次赢回全部亏损。胜率很高，但偶尔会出现毁灭性的亏损。

terms.formula: Lot size after n consecutive losses = initial lot × 2ⁿ

heading.en: Why it looks good in backtests

paragraphs.en: Most of the time price eventually comes back, so the doubled position closes with a small profit and the equity curve rises smoothly. The risk is hidden in the rare long losing streak: after ten losses the position is 1,024 times the original size, and the account usually runs out of margin first.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数时候价格最终会回来，加倍后的仓位以小盈利平仓，权益曲线看起来平滑上涨。风险藏在少见的长连败里：连亏 10 次后仓位是初始的 1024 倍，通常还没等到反弹账户就爆了。

paragraphs.en: Look for lot multipliers or “recovery” parameters in the EA settings, a win rate far above 80%, and a maximum drawdown that is small for years and then suddenly huge. The EA Arena tags EAs that scale position size after losses with a Martingale category and a higher risk rating.
paragraphs.zh: 看 EA 参数里有没有手数倍数、“回本”之类的设置，胜率是否远高于 80%，最大回撤是否多年很小、然后突然巨大。EA 竞技场会把亏损后加仓的 EA 归到马丁格尔分类，并给出更高的风险等级。

short.en: The root-mean-square of drawdowns: it grows with both how deep and how long the equity stays below its peak.
short.zh: 回撤的均方根：权益跌得越深、在前高下方待得越久，数值越大。

terms.formula: Ulcer = √( mean( (Equity_t / max(Equity_0..t) − 1)² ) )

heading.en: Why it is better than max drawdown alone
heading.zh: 为什么比只看最大回撤更好

paragraphs.en: Maximum drawdown only remembers the single worst moment. The Ulcer index looks at every day: a strategy that spends years 10% below its peak scores worse than one that briefly fell 15% and recovered quickly. That matches how painful a strategy actually is to hold. Quant Arena reports it as a percentage and also uses it in the drawdown component of the Arena Score.
paragraphs.zh: 最大回撤只记住最糟的那一刻；Ulcer 指数看的是每一天。一个在前高下方 10% 处待了好几年的策略，会比短暂跌 15% 又很快修复的策略得分更差，这更符合拿着它的真实感受。Quant Arena 以百分比展示它，并把它用在 Arena Score 的回撤控制分项里。

paragraphs.en: Dividing the annual growth rate by the Ulcer index gives the Martin ratio (also called the Ulcer performance index): return per unit of drawdown pain, a useful alternative to the Sharpe ratio for strategies with long flat periods.
paragraphs.zh: 用年化增长率除以 Ulcer 指数，就得到 Martin 比率（也叫 Ulcer 绩效指数）：每承受一单位回撤痛苦能换来多少收益。对经常长时间空仓的策略，它是夏普比率之外很好的补充。

short.en: The share of days a strategy actually held a position. Low exposure explains low win rates and low volatility.
short.zh: 策略真正持有仓位的交易日占比。持仓时间少，能解释为什么胜率和波动率都偏低。

terms.formula: Exposure ≈ days with a non-zero strategy return / all days

paragraphs.en: We count the days on which the strategy's return was not zero. Days in cash have exactly zero return, so this is a close proxy for the share of time a position was open. Strategies with less than 5% exposure in a window are not ranked by the Arena Score for that window.
paragraphs.zh: 我们统计策略日收益不为 0 的天数。空仓的日子收益恰好是 0，所以这个比例很接近真实的持仓时间占比。某个窗口内持仓时间不到 5% 的策略，在该窗口不参与 Arena Score 排名。

paragraphs.en: A strategy that is invested half the time can match buy-and-hold returns with half the risk, or it can miss the best days of a bull market. Exposure tells you which kind of strategy you are looking at before you compare returns.
paragraphs.zh: 一个只有一半时间持仓的策略，可能用一半的风险拿到和买入持有差不多的收益，也可能正好错过牛市里涨得最猛的那几天。比较收益之前，先看持仓时间占比，就知道自己在看哪一类策略。

short.en: Beta measures how much a strategy moves with its market; alpha is the return left over after accounting for that.
short.zh: Beta 衡量策略跟着市场一起动的程度；Alpha 是扣除这部分之后剩下的收益。

terms.formula: Beta = cov(strategy, asset) / var(asset);  Alpha = (mean(strategy) − Beta·mean(asset)) × 252

paragraphs.en: A beta of 1 means the strategy moves one-for-one with buy-and-hold on the same asset; 0.3 means it carries about a third of the market's moves, typically because it is often in cash. Positive alpha means the timing added return beyond what that exposure would explain. Quant Arena computes both against buy-and-hold of the same market, and also reports correlation, the information ratio and up- and down-capture.
paragraphs.zh: Beta 为 1，说明策略和同一品种的买入持有同涨同跌；0.3 说明只承担了大约三分之一的市场波动，通常是因为经常空仓。Alpha 为正，说明择时带来了这部分敞口解释不了的额外收益。Quant Arena 都以同一品种的买入持有为基准计算，同时提供相关系数、信息比率和上/下行捕获率。

paragraphs.en: Up capture is the strategy's average return on days the market rose, divided by the market's average gain on those days; down capture does the same for falling days. The ideal timing strategy keeps up capture high and down capture low.
paragraphs.zh: 上行捕获率是市场上涨日里策略平均收益除以市场平均涨幅；下行捕获率是下跌日的同样计算。理想的择时策略，上行捕获率高、下行捕获率低。

title.en: Probabilistic and Deflated Sharpe Ratio (PSR, DSR)
title.zh: 概率夏普与 Deflated 夏普（PSR、DSR）

short.en: The probability that a strategy's true Sharpe ratio is above zero, given how long and how lumpy its track record is.
short.zh: 结合收益记录的长度和形状，策略真实夏普比率大于 0 的概率。

terms.formula: PSR = Φ( SR·√(n−1) / √(1 − skew·SR + (kurt−1)/4·SR²) ),  SR = daily Sharpe

paragraphs.en: A Sharpe ratio of 1 measured over three months means much less than the same value over ten years, and fat-tailed or negatively skewed returns make it even less reliable. The PSR, proposed by Bailey and López de Prado, turns the observed Sharpe into a probability that takes sample length, skewness and kurtosis into account.
paragraphs.zh: 三个月测出来的夏普 1.0，和十年测出来的夏普 1.0，含金量完全不同；收益分布有肥尾或负偏时，可信度还会更低。Bailey 和 López de Prado 提出的 PSR，把样本长度、偏度和峰度都考虑进来，把观测到的夏普转换成一个概率。

heading.zh: 在 Quant Arena 里怎么用

paragraphs.en: Above 95% is strong evidence of a positive edge in that window; around 50% means the result is indistinguishable from luck. PSR is the significance component of the Arena Score.
paragraphs.zh: 高于 95% 说明在该窗口内有比较可靠的正向优势；50% 左右说明和运气区分不开。PSR 是 Arena Score 中统计可信度这一项。

paragraphs.en: PSR alone ignores that we test many strategies at once: with enough tries, one of them will look good by chance. The Deflated Sharpe Ratio (DSR) raises the bar to the best Sharpe you would expect from luck among all strategies on the same market and window, then asks the same question. Strategy pages show both. In our own data no strategy clears 95% on the DSR over five years, which is a useful reminder of how much of any leaderboard is noise.
paragraphs.zh: PSR 没有考虑我们同时测试了很多策略：试的次数够多，总有一个会碰巧看起来很好。Deflated 夏普（DSR）把门槛提高到“同一市场、同一窗口内所有策略单靠运气能达到的最好夏普”，再问同样的问题。策略页会同时显示这两个数。在我们自己的数据里，近五年没有任何策略的 DSR 超过 95%，这也提醒我们：任何排行榜里都有相当一部分是噪音。

short.en: VaR is the daily loss exceeded on only 5% of days; CVaR is the average loss on those worst days.
short.zh: VaR 是只有 5% 的交易日会超过的日亏损；CVaR 是这些最糟交易日的平均亏损。

terms.formula: VaR95 = 5th percentile of daily returns;  CVaR95 = mean of returns ≤ VaR95

paragraphs.en: A daily VaR of −2% means that on about one day in twenty the strategy lost more than 2%. CVaR (expected shortfall) answers the follow-up question: when those bad days happen, how bad are they on average? A CVaR far below the VaR signals fat tails, which is common for leveraged, grid and martingale-style systems. Quant Arena computes both historically from daily strategy returns, without assuming a normal distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 日 VaR 为 −2%，意思是大约每 20 个交易日里有一天亏损超过 2%。CVaR（预期亏损）回答的是下一个问题：这些坏日子来的时候，平均有多坏？CVaR 比 VaR 低很多，说明有肥尾，这在加杠杆、网格和马丁类系统里很常见。Quant Arena 直接用历史日收益计算，不假设正态分布。

short.en: A range for CAGR or maximum drawdown that shows how much the result depends on the particular order of good and bad days in the backtest.
short.zh: 给年化收益或最大回撤一个区间，用来看回测结果有多依赖历史上好日子和坏日子出现的具体顺序。

terms.formula: Resample daily returns in 20-day blocks 500 times → CAGR and max drawdown of each path → 5th and 95th percentiles

paragraphs.en: A backtest produces one equity curve, but that curve is only one of many paths the same strategy could have taken. The bootstrap cuts the strategy's daily returns into 20-day blocks, shuffles the blocks into 500 new histories of the same length, and computes CAGR and maximum drawdown for each. Quant Arena shows the range that covers the middle 90% of those paths, and the share of paths that ended with a loss. Blocks rather than single days keep trends and volatile stretches together.
paragraphs.zh: 一次回测只给出一条权益曲线，但这只是同一个策略可能走出的众多路径之一。Bootstrap 把策略的日收益切成 20 天一段，打乱顺序后重新拼成 500 条同样长度的历史，分别算出年化收益和最大回撤。Quant Arena 展示覆盖中间 90% 路径的区间，以及最终亏损的路径占比。按段而不是按天抽样，是为了保留趋势和高波动时期的连续性。

paragraphs.en: A narrow interval means the result came from many similar days and is less likely to be luck. A wide interval — for example a CAGR range of −5% to +30% — means a few lucky or unlucky stretches drove the outcome. Compare the lower end of the CAGR range across strategies rather than the single headline number, and treat the drawdown range as a realistic worst case: the drawdown you live through can easily be deeper than the one the backtest happened to show. The bootstrap still assumes the future looks like the past; it does not account for regime changes or overfitting.
paragraphs.zh: 区间窄，说明结果来自大量相似的交易日，靠运气的可能性小；区间宽，比如年化收益在 −5% 到 +30% 之间，说明少数几段好运或坏运决定了结果。比较策略时，与其看单一的年化数字，不如看区间的下限；回撤区间则可以当作更现实的最坏情况——实盘里遇到的回撤完全可能比回测碰巧给出的更深。需要注意，Bootstrap 仍然假设未来和过去相似，它不考虑市场环境的变化，也不能纠正过拟合。

short.en: Net return divided by the maximum drawdown: how many times a strategy earned back its worst fall.
short.zh: 净收益除以最大回撤，表示策略把最糟的一次亏损赚回了几遍。

terms.formula: Recovery factor = net return (%) / maximum drawdown (%)

paragraphs.en: For every EA backtest we divide the net return over the test (one year of hourly data, as a share of the $10,000 starting balance) by the maximum drawdown, the largest peak-to-trough fall of the account in percent. MetaTrader's strategy tester uses dollar amounts instead; the two give similar numbers when the drawdown happens close to the starting balance. A losing EA has a negative recovery factor.
paragraphs.zh: 每条 EA 回测都用整个回测期（一年的小时线数据）的净收益率（相对 1 万美元初始资金），除以最大回撤，也就是账户从高点到低点的最大跌幅（按百分比）。MT5 策略测试器用的是美元金额；回撤发生在初始资金附近时，两种算法的结果差不多。亏钱的 EA 恢复因子为负。

heading.zh: 我们的 EA 回测结果

paragraphs.en: Across the 1,123 reliable EA backtests on four markets (hourly data from May 2025 to May 2026), the median recovery factor was **about zero**: the typical EA did not earn back its worst drawdown even once. 240 results (21%) reached 1 or more, and only 55 (5%) reached 3.
paragraphs.zh: 在四个品种上的 1,123 条可信 EA 回测里（2025 年 5 月至 2026 年 5 月的小时线），恢复因子的中位数**大约是 0**：典型的 EA 连一次最大回撤都没有赚回来。达到 1 以上的有 240 条（21%），达到 3 以上的只有 55 条（5%）。

paragraphs.en: Even among the 562 profitable results, 322 had a recovery factor below 1. They ended in profit, but made less than they had been down at their worst point — a year that a real trader would have had to sit through.
paragraphs.zh: 即使在 562 条盈利结果里，也有 322 条恢复因子低于 1。它们最后是赚钱的，但赚的比最糟时亏的还少——真实交易时，这一年得硬扛过那段回撤。

paragraphs.en: Read it together with the length of the test. Over one year, a recovery factor of 2–3 is solid; over ten years the same number is weak, because there was far more time to earn it.
paragraphs.zh: 要结合回测时长来看。一年期里恢复因子到 2–3 算不错；如果是十年期，同样的数字就偏弱了，因为赚钱的时间长得多。

paragraphs.en: It rests on a single number — the worst drawdown — so a strategy that has not yet met its bad market can look better than it is. The Calmar ratio uses annual return instead of total profit and is easier to compare across periods.
paragraphs.zh: 它只依赖一个数——最大回撤——所以还没遇到不利行情的策略会显得比实际好。卡玛比率用年化收益代替总利润，跨时间段比较更方便。

short.en: The risk that an account loses so much that the broker closes every position. In our backtests on hourly data from May 2025 to May 2026, 61 of 307 gold runs with default lot sizes ended this way; on three currency pairs, none did.
short.zh: 账户亏损到被券商强制平掉全部仓位的风险。在我们用 2025 年 5 月至 2026 年 5 月小时线做的回测里，用默认手数交易黄金的 307 条 EA 结果中有 61 条爆仓，三个外汇品种上一条都没有。

terms.formula: Margin level = equity / used margin × 100%; the broker closes positions when it falls below its stop-out level

paragraphs.en: Brokers track the margin level: equity divided by the margin tied up in open positions. When it falls below the broker's stop-out level, positions are closed, starting with the biggest loser, until the margin level recovers. Stop-out levels differ by broker, so check yours.
paragraphs.zh: 券商会盯着保证金比例：净值除以持仓占用的保证金。一旦跌破券商规定的强平线，就会从亏损最大的仓位开始强制平仓，直到比例恢复。各家券商的强平线不同，要以自己的券商为准。

paragraphs.en: Each EA runs with its own default lot size on a $10,000 account with 1:100 leverage. If equity falls to 10% of the starting balance, open positions are closed and the EA stops trading, like a broker stop-out. A price gap that pushes the balance below zero is reset to zero, as with negative balance protection.
paragraphs.zh: 每个 EA 都用自己的默认手数，在 1 万美元、1:100 杠杆的账户上运行。净值跌到初始资金的 10% 时平掉所有仓位并停止交易，相当于券商强平。如果价格跳空让余额变成负数，就按负余额保护归零。

paragraphs.en: **In the backtests on hourly data from May 2025 to May 2026, 61 of the 307 reliable gold (XAUUSD) runs ended in a stop-out. None of the 911 on EUR/USD, GBP/USD and USD/JPY did.** A lot size that is modest on a currency pair is large on gold: 0.1 lot is 10 ounces, so every $10 move in the gold price changes the account by $100.
paragraphs.zh: **在 2025 年 5 月至 2026 年 5 月小时线的回测里，307 条可信的黄金（XAUUSD）结果中有 61 条爆仓，而 EUR/USD、GBP/USD、USD/JPY 上的 911 条一条都没有。** 在外汇上不算大的手数，放到黄金上就很重：0.1 手是 10 盎司，金价每动 10 美元，账户就变动 100 美元。

paragraphs.en: Most of the EAs that blew up on gold had a stop loss: 42 of the 59 whose code we could assess. A stop sized in pips for a currency pair can still be far too wide, in dollars, on gold.
paragraphs.zh: 黄金上爆仓的 EA 大多其实设了止损：能评估代码的 59 个中有 42 个。按外汇点数设的止损，换到黄金上按美元算可能还是太宽。

paragraphs.en: Martingale and grid EAs rarely appear among the stop-outs only because most of them could not be converted for testing: just 17 of the 70 martingale EAs and 2 of the 21 grid EAs have a reliable backtest.
paragraphs.zh: 马丁和网格 EA 在爆仓名单里很少，只是因为它们大多没法转换来回测：70 个马丁 EA 中只有 17 个、21 个网格 EA 中只有 2 个有可信的回测结果。

paragraphs.en: Every EA page shows a blow-up risk label built from the EA's code and our backtests. **High**: the account was stopped out in our backtest, or the EA adds to losing positions (martingale or grid) without a stop loss. **Elevated**: martingale or grid sizing with a stop loss, or several positions at once without a stop loss. Otherwise we say no blow-up pattern was found, which is not a promise of safety.
paragraphs.zh: 每个 EA 页面都有一个根据代码和回测得出的爆仓风险标签。**高**：回测中爆仓，或在亏损时加仓（马丁或网格）且不设止损。**偏高**：马丁或网格加仓但设了止损，或不设止损且可以同时持有多个仓位。其余的标为“未发现爆仓模式”，这不代表安全。

paragraphs.en: Of the 1,061 trading EAs we could assess, 93 are rated high and 66 elevated.
paragraphs.zh: 在能评估的 1,061 个交易型 EA 中，93 个为高，66 个为偏高。

en: Size positions by risk, not by a fixed lot: choose the stop first, then the lot size so that one losing trade costs a small, fixed share of equity.
Be wary of EAs that add to losing positions unless the total exposure is capped.
Test an EA on the exact symbol you will trade, with your broker's contract size and leverage, before running it live.
zh: 按风险定仓位，而不是固定手数：先定止损，再算手数，让每笔亏损只占净值的一小部分。
对亏损时加仓的 EA 要格外小心，除非总敞口有上限。
实盘前，用你要交易的品种、你券商的合约规格和杠杆重新测一遍。
